schedule_info.instructions: The input is a social media post written by a VTuber. Does this post contain schedule information about an upcoming stream, collaboration, or event (such as its date, start time, planned content, time change, postponement, cancellation, day off, or undecided status)?

criteria.true_description: States a future or today's upcoming stream schedule, start time, planned topic, time change, postponement, cancellation, day off, or tentative plan.
criteria.false_description: Greetings, thanks, already-started or going-live-right-now link drops without schedule info, merch or VOD/Shorts promotions, or casual chat.

kind.instructions: The input is a social media post written by a VTuber. What kind of stream schedule message is this post?

criteria.announce: Announces the date, start time, or planned content of a specific upcoming stream or collaboration.
criteria.change: Changes the start time, date, content, or tentative status of a previously planned stream.
criteria.cancel: Cancels, postpones, or announces a day off from streaming.
criteria.weekly: Presents a weekly schedule covering multiple days.
criteria.other: Anything outside these categories, including greetings, going-live-now posts, merch or video promotions, and casual chat.
